reason: Both identify the identical root cause: the subquery `SELECT MAX(id) FROM runs WHERE status = 'failed'` has an inverted filter (should exclude failed runs, instead selects them). Both describe the same two consequent failure modes: (1) when no run has ever failed, the subquery returns NULL, causing the gauge to report an empty/zero backlog permanently; (2) when a failed run exists, the gauge incorrectly keys off that failed run's state instead of the last real observation, overwriting/losing legitimate prior data. This is a paraphrase of the same underlying mechanism, not a different bug.
